newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 12.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:
* "The Lost World: Jurassic Park" became the first movie to surpass $200 million overseas this year.
* Diane Keaton has signed to star in "Other Sister", Garry Marshall's movie for Disney's Touchstone Pictures.
* Neil LaBute is in final talks for a non-exclusive first-look deal with Propaganda Films.
* Universal Studios has has tapped Disney TV veteran David Kissinger to lead the effort to produce more sitcoms.
* Universal Home Video will launch the homevideo of Steven Spielberg's "The Lost World: Jurassic Park," on Nov. 4.
